== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The Kazan are a formidable clan known for their aggressive maneuvering and military presence. They often travel with large, thundering armies accompanied by trumpets and banners featuring the Stone Dogs. Their territory is heavily fortified with walls made of large bricks reinforced by old [[scripts]] and bronze gates accented with Goldsteel{{!}}goldsteel or [[halfsilver]]. The clan is characterized by a culture of constant preparedness, where every member—including women and children—wears various forms of armor or protective clothing. They also wear large, highly detailed metal badges on their chests to signify their status or role. Members of the clan follow specific magical paths, such as the [[Path of the Mountain’s Heart]], which allows certain individuals like Forgers to manifest [[constructs]] such as heavy bricks or crushing weapons from [[madra]]. The clan is led by a Jai Patriarch{{!}}Patriarch, described as a sturdy, bearded man who wears chainmail and a bear's pelt. While the Kazan are known to raid neighboring territories like the [[Li]] and Wei, they also possess a sense of honor and can engage in good-faith negotiations. However, they are also viewed with suspicion by others due to their potential for deception and aggressive territorial expansion.}}
